motion.name: utility-control
motion.purpose: Button background, border and colour transitions.

motion.name: answer-sequence
motion.purpose: 400ms accepted-answer entrance, 600ms hold, 500ms return; reduced motion uses static poses and a 150ms fade.

motion.name: mark-state
motion.purpose: Supplied four-quarter custom element state morph, with a 3.2s stepped thinking loop and 3.4s resting breath.

components.name: Dialog field
components.description: Dark field with a persistent label.
components.css: .ds-field{display:grid;gap:8px;color:#c6c6c6;font:14px system-ui}.ds-field input{min-height:36px;padding:8px 12px;border:1px solid #6f6f6f;border-radius:4px;background:#262626;color:#f4f4f4;font:inherit}.ds-field input:hover{border-color:#c6c6c6}.ds-field input:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #3ddbd9;outline-offset:2px}.ds-field input:disabled{opacity:.5}

components.name: Identity chip
components.description: Coloured theme dot and neutral label.

narrative.overview: Existing Carbon g100 desktop application with restrained teal actions, dense work surfaces and readable embedded AI. This is documentation, not a redesign.

rules.name: Single gutter
rules.body: Apply horizontal panel padding once; nested sections share the text edge.

rules.name: Semantic colour
rules.body: Preserve content-type, project and topic meanings; colour is never the only label.

rules.name: Diagram fills
rules.body: On the off-white diagram sheet use stronger IBM 30 fills paired with darker borders in the same hue family: Blue #a6c8ff, Purple #d4bbff, Cyan #82cfff, Teal #3ddbd9, Green #6fdc8c, Magenta #ffafd2, Red #ffb3b8, Yellow #f1c21b and Orange #ffb784. Preserve custom colours. Shared selection styles leave mixed values unchanged until chosen.

dos: Use existing tokens and complete interactive states.
donts: Do not introduce a new UI kit or marketing composition.
Do not change system accessibility settings.
